name: spindoctor_qwerty
description: Run the SpinDoctor 3.1.2 quantum-circuit SIMULATOR (classical FP64 on the Flowise server, not a quantum computer; 1-298 logical qubits). action=script runs q.* commands; action=folder runs a folder of command files; action=preset runs qc-001..qc-241; action=list lists presets; action=report reads a report; action=functions returns the function table (show it verbatim); action=theory tests a theory (for a theory from the chat, summarise it and get the user to confirm first). Never present results as quantum hardware or quantum advantage.
schema: [{"id": 0, "property": "action", "type": "string", "required": true, "description": "One of: script, folder, preset, list, report, functions, theory"}, {"id": 1, "property": "input", "type": "string", "required": false, "description": "script: q.* commands, one per line; folder: absolute folder path (runs q.folder); preset: id plus optional name=value overrides; list: filter text; report: report name (empty lists recent reports); functions: section (commands|gates|tools|presets|all) plus optional filter; theory: JSON object with the spindoctor_test_theory fields (source file|text|chat, path, text, excerpts, hypothesis, prediction, script, checks)"}]
